landing.heroTitle: Create elegant invitations, from A to Z.
landing.heroSubtitle: Save the Date, invitations, unique QR code per guest, RSVP and entry control: manage your event end to end from a single platform.
landing.feature1Body: Save the Date, invitations, posters, badges and access cards — customize every piece in a modern visual editor.
landing.feature2Body: Each guest gets their own invitation and QR code. On the day, your agents scan and control entries, even offline.
landing.feature3Body: Collect confirmations, send automated reminders and track attendance in real time, from the first guest to the final report.
landing.howStep2: Design your pieces in the studio
landing.footerNote: Built for beautiful days. Multi-tenant, multi-currency, FR/EN.
